question: By what multiples may the drain chamber width be increased from the base measure?
premises: A base measure for the drain chamber exists
Permitted enlargements are twofold or threefold
inference: The drain chamber width may be made two or three times the base measure.
uncertainties: Spelling nālīgehaviśālakam differs from nālīgṛhaviśālakam in earlier verse
plain_english: The width of the drain chamber may even be two or three times that measure.
